title: Response Allowance from the Latest Clinical Information on a Quantity Limit Renewal
content:
The most recent clinical information for the drug adds a response allowance to the renewal approval ceiling of a quantity limit renewal under the Utilization Management Program.

| Ground of the most recent clinical information received for the drug | Units added |
|---|---|
| documented response to therapy | 2 |
| the quantity is medically necessary | 1 |
| any other ground | 0 |
| no clinical information on file for the drug | 0 |

Only the most recent clinical information received for the drug is read; an earlier receipt with a different ground does not count.

*Hypothetical cases:*
- The prescriber's latest information documents response to therapy: 2 units.
- An earlier receipt documented response to therapy, but the latest one states that the quantity is medically necessary: 1 unit.
